input: The exact command prettier --check src/card.ts identifies a spacing defect in that file. Inspection confirms spacing alone is wrong. The pinned Prettier version and config are installed locally; --write and --check are available for these files.

The formatting job lists 45 Markdown files with the same whitespace defect. Inspection confirms every reported failure is formatting only. The pinned Prettier version and config are installed locally; --write and --check are available for these files.
notes: File count alone is not disqualifying.

input: The exact formatter command flags .github/workflows/test.yml. Parsing before and after confirms identical YAML values and execution behavior. Only formatting changes. The pinned Prettier version and config are installed locally; --write and --check are available for these files.
notes: Workflow file location is not a behavioral judgment.

input: Four matrix jobs run the same pinned formatter and report identical spacing errors in src/input.ts. Their relevant environments match, and inspection confirms a single cause. The pinned Prettier version and config are installed locally; --write and --check are available for these files.
notes: Repeated jobs need not imply multiple causes.

input: The exact formatter command flags tests/cart.test.ts. Inspection confirms whitespace-only correction, preserving every assertion and execution order. The pinned Prettier version and config are installed locally; --write and --check are available for these files.
notes: Test file editing is not necessarily assertion editing.

input: The formatter flags indentation outside the snapshot strings in a test file. Inspection confirms all snapshot bytes and assertions remain unchanged. The pinned Prettier version and config are installed locally; --write and --check are available for these files.

The exact compiler error names the private annotation Cusotmer. The same file defines Customer and inspection establishes this single typo; correcting it changes no API or runtime behavior. The checked-in TypeScript version is installed; pnpm typecheck runs the same tsconfig as CI.
notes: Narrow compiler correction with unambiguous intent.

input: The compiler identifies a misspelled type-only import in one file. The intended export and its use are unambiguous; the correction changes no runtime import or public API. The checked-in TypeScript version is installed; pnpm typecheck runs the same tsconfig as CI.

The exact formatter command flags a generated documentation file. The generator already emitted correct content; inspection confirms only whitespace needs changing. The pinned Prettier version and config are installed locally; --write and --check are available for these files.
notes: Generated status alone is not disqualifying.

input: The exact formatter command flags whitespace in a CSS file. Inspection confirms selectors, declarations, values, and ordering are unchanged by its correction. The pinned Prettier version and config are installed locally; --write and --check are available for these files.
Logs and inspection identify a spacing-only defect and a deterministic correction, but its formatter cannot run locally and no appropriate equivalent check is available.
CI reports lint failed but does not identify the command or files. The engineer suspects formatting and proposes formatting the whole tree.
notes: Exact command and affected files are unknown.

input: The compiler names one file and a parser error. Inspection finds two plausible causes: stale generated syntax or a missing source delimiter. Local compilation is available but has not distinguished them.
A snapshot assertion fails after a rendered label changed. Regeneration is deterministic and available locally, but nobody has established which label is intended.
notes: Deterministic generation does not settle behavior.

input: The compiler rejects nullable data used as a User. An as User cast silences it, but callers have not established whether null is valid at runtime.
Install logs identify a peer conflict and exact packages. Regenerating the lockfile can resolve it, but selecting compatible versions requires a judgment.
All callers of a composite action fail during setup. Inspection identifies its runtime setting; changing it changes their shared environment and requires consumer validation.
The job logs permission denied. Adding a token scope would unblock it, but the intended security boundary and operations need checking.
A compiler error disappears if an exported method return type changes. The cause and files are known, but downstream consumers depend on that contract.
notes: A narrow edit can change a public API.

input: A lint autofix rewrites a boolean expression. Inspection shows it changes when a callback executes; intended runtime behavior is unknown even though lint passes.
A whitespace defect was initially mechanical. After formatting, the same local check still fails on that file with an unexplained parser error.
A supposedly mechanical formatter unexpectedly rewrites dependency declarations and deletes test cases along with spacing.
A mechanically verified formatting fix was pushed. CI now fails with an unexplained compiler error in another file; its relationship to the fix is unknown.
A lesson says this signature always means a harmless typo. Current inspection instead supports two possible runtime data-shape causes and no reproduction yet distinguishes them.
